question: Should the listed focused tests and hosted checks be accepted for this internal refactor, or must the exact head demonstrate a real Gateway agent RPC lifecycle before merge?
rationale: The patch is behavior-sensitive despite intending no user-visible change, and the visible evidence does not show the changed session lifecycle operating in a real Gateway setup.

options.title: Require runtime lifecycle proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head output or logs demonstrate admission, persistence, completion, and cleanup during a real Gateway agent RPC run.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A lifecycle owner may explicitly accept the focused tests, hosted checks, and manual invariant review as sufficient for this behavior-preserving refactor.

recommendation.title: Require runtime lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head output or logs demonstrate admission, persistence, completion, and cleanup during a real Gateway agent RPC run.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked program ownership, implementation history, and submitted lifecycle analysis make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the proof decision.
